content.short: Tulipa Capital is a DeFi asset manager curating on-chain vaults, active since 2019.
content.description: Tulipa Capital has managed DeFi positions since 2019 and now curates on-chain vaults, including on Monad. Longevity is a meaningful credential in this particular role, since a curator's job is mostly about what they decline to lend against, and that judgement is usually formed by having been present for previous failures.
